verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI provides multiple clear bulk-operation mechanisms: batch API calls with URL lists and priority (crawl4ai-gh-23), multi-URL configuration with per-pattern strategies (crawl4ai-gh-10), deep/BFS crawling with max-pages limits (crawl4ai-gh-2), high-performance parallel crawling (crawl4ai-docs-7), and checkpoint/resume support for long-running bulk jobs (crawl4ai-gh-8, crawl4ai-gh-25).
